name: Trinity
overview: The doctrine of the Trinity is revealed through Scripture's depiction of God as a unity expressed in plurality. In Genesis, God speaks in the plural, saying 'Let us make man in our image' and 'Behold, the man is become as one of us,' indicating a complex unity. Isaiah further reveals the distinct roles within the Godhead, with the Spirit of the LORD resting upon the Messiah and the LORD speaking of sending 'us,' highlighting the relational nature of the divine persons. The thrice-repeated 'Holy, holy, holy' in Isaiah 6 emphasizes God's perfect holiness, underscoring the unity and distinctiveness within the one true God.
